packageRules.description: Every minor, patch and digest update in one pull request a week.

go-amqp 1.5.1 on reports a link the broker refuses to attach: azservicebus opens a $management link with every sender, which floci-az's broker (the azure-servicebus pack's integration test) has no address for on a topic, so sending to a topic fails. azservicebus 1.11 needs go-amqp 1.7. Tried again with floci-az 0.17.0: the same (AMQ119002, no customs-events/$management).

go-ora v3.0.1, the latest v3 release, fails every connection after a program's first with EOF against Oracle 23 (its FastLogin cookie replay, sijms/go-ora#732): the sql pack's pool opens several. The fix is on go-ora's master (a968e590) and in no release yet. Move to v3 by hand once one has it, with the sql pack's Oracle integration tests.

The WireMock extension's OpenAPI validator (Atlassian's openapi-request-validator-core 3.0.0, its latest) is compiled against json-schema-validator 2.x and Jackson 2: 3.x takes Jackson 3's JsonNode, and the validator's calls fail on it with NoSuchMethodError. The jar's own line stays on 2.x until the validator moves; the tests' line (already 3.x) is not held. The two are patterns: Gradle's versioning reads no range like <3.0.0, and a rule whose current version does not match holds nothing.
@types/vscode is the oldest VS Code the extension supports (engines.vscode in ide/vscode/package.json): vsce refuses newer types. Raise both together, by hand.

@types/node is the Node.js of the oldest VS Code the extension supports (engines.vscode ^1.91.0 runs Node 20; esbuild.mjs targets node20): newer types would let the extension use what that VS Code lacks. Raise it with engines.vscode, by hand.

The models-core pack's Python runtimes are compiled with uv pip compile (each file's header gives the command), from their requirements.in: a bump of one line cannot resolve (executorch pins mpmath==1.3.0, say). Recompile them together, by hand, with --upgrade and --exclude-newer of two weeks back, and pin what is that old; then run the models-core pack's integration tests. piper-tts stays at 1.2.0, the MIT release (1.3.0 on is GPL-3.0).

customManagers.description: WireMock in the axx-wiremock image. WIREMOCK_SHA256 needs a manual update; the image build fails until it matches.
The Lighthouse the web-lighthouse pack names; npm/package.json and its lockfile pin the same one. It must suit the Chromium of the Playwright the web pack drives: a person checks before it merges.

The Oracle the sql pack's integration tests run, pinned by its digest: its tag is given to each new Oracle release, and one may answer the driver another way (23.26.4 did, for VECTOR columns). A new digest merges when those tests pass on it.

The Db2 the sql pack's integration tests run, IBM's Db2 Community Edition, pinned by its digest. A new release merges when those tests pass on it; the client's recorded sessions (packs/sql/internal/db2/testdata) are of the release they were recorded on, and are recorded again on the new one.
The Delve axx builds for --debug-steps. It must support the Go release axx is built with.
